name: Huldar
summary: Along Loch Modan’s southern road, Huldar’s powder run has come to a halt. His wagon carries blast powder for the southern dig, but threats on the road have put the delivery in danger.

sections.title: A Powder Run in Peril
sections.body: Huldar’s wagon is stranded on the road through southern Loch Modan. He was sent with loads of mining blast powder for the excavation site, where dwarven archaeologists and prospectors need supplies. Local wildlife and troggs threaten the route near the lake’s southern bend. Dark Iron infiltrators also lurk there. With his wagon damaged, Huldar depends on passing travelers to guard the remaining powder kegs and carry the shipment to the dig.

faq.answer: Huldar is a dwarven teamster stranded by his wagon on Loch Modan’s southern bank. He was hauling blast powder to the nearby excavation site when the run went wrong.
Huldar’s wagon carries barrels of blast powder. Dwarven prospectors and archaeologists at the southern excavation site need the explosives.

faq.q: Why is Huldar stuck on the road?
faq.answer: Hostile beasts, troggs, and Dark Iron dwarf saboteurs threaten the roads through southern Loch Modan. An ambush stopped Huldar’s shipment, leaving him to seek help guarding and delivering the remaining supplies.

faq.q: Why do the Dark Iron dwarves care about his cargo?
faq.answer: The Dark Iron clan seeks to undermine Ironforge’s presence and historical research throughout Loch Modan. Cutting off blast powder can halt excavation and deprive dwarven operations of defensive and industrial supplies.

angles.text: As a dwarf, helping Huldar supports the Explorer's League dig site and supplies your kin with powder to unearth ancient titan secrets.
As an engineer, you know raw blast powder is valuable and volatile, especially in exposed wooden barrels.
